scope: PublicationView native result/authority reading, annual-update baseline and three-position reporting, and the two CLI import-path fixes only; no review of the future continuity stage.

findings.title: Valid pending-publication outcome exits as failure
findings.reproduction: inspect_annual_update with an existing FY2025 candidate ahead of an FY2024 published test baseline returns CANDIDATE_PENDING_PUBLICATION. The CLI status-routing unit returns exit 2 because its success set still contains only NO_NEW_ANNUAL_FILING and INPUT_READY.
findings.impact: A routine successful check with retained publication work is reported as a command failure, preventing reliable normal-flow handling.
findings.minimal_fix: Include the new normal pending-publication outcome in the CLI success routing; keep actual CHECK_FAILED outcomes nonzero.

findings.title: Known publication work depends on successful input inspection
findings.reproduction: With a real FY2025 successful candidate and FY2024 published test baseline, an unavailable ledger yields CHECK_FAILED and publication_work=UNKNOWN, although the candidate/publication relationship is already known. With no published baseline supplied, publication_work becomes NONE rather than unknown/not supplied.
findings.impact: The new three-position report loses known pending publication work when source inspection fails and asserts no work when publication state was not supplied.
findings.minimal_fix: Compute and retain publication relationship after baseline validation and before source reads. Distinguish missing publication state from a verified synchronized state. Preserve it when a later input check fails.

bounded_followup_integration_notes.detail: The existing runtime calls inspect_annual_update without published, then sets current_published afterward. If this existing entry reports the new work fields, it must supply that known baseline or leave publication state explicitly unknown; simply adding the display field afterward cannot compute pending status. This is an existing-callsite note, not review of the unimplemented new stage.

The inherited result run_path is relative to owner_publication_id, while published_baseline records the outer view.bundle_dir. For a true inherited coordinate, callers need an explicit owner bundle path or an unambiguous bundle-relative inherited path; do not imply the outer bundle plus the leaf-local run_path is directly resolvable.

read_status_cases.evidence_scope: Bounded status logic using actual native baseline records as explicit test inputs; not a report of actual formal rollback. CLI check function substituted only to test exit-code routing.

recommended_fast_regressions: Current adopted B10 has the same Result content id as R3 but a different Run/execution: resolve the adopted owner and never fall back.
Missing/invalid adopted record with an older valid predecessor present must reject; no fallback to the older answer.

Explicit inherited binding follows only the declared predecessor, preserves requested/owner IDs and gives a resolvable owner path; wrong predecessor, duplicate binding, unknown origin and cycle reject.
R3 delta B10 and v1 adopted B10 remain readable; an unavailable inherited native coordinate has an explicit unavailable result/error, not guessed parent provenance.
Candidate ahead of published, same fiscal filing with a different Run, and exact same native Run yield distinct publication-work states with zero model work when input is unchanged.
Input-source failure preserves known pending publication state; omitted published baseline does not report NONE.
CLI returns zero for the valid pending-publication check and nonzero for genuine check failure.
Authority-byte reads remain manifest-bound and reject traversal, absolute paths and unlisted current state.
execution_scope: Original repo, prior history and 2026-09-09 artifacts were OS write-denied and network-denied for the exercised reader/status checks. One actual current PublicationView cold read was performed (54.875s); no complete stage execution or provider/SEC request occurred. CLI check was substituted only for the isolated exit-code-routing unit, not to fabricate native content validation.
